title: Prevent read-only reviewers from mutating Beads internals
outcome: Both TermAl read-only /review-local delegations reported changes under .beads/embeddeddolt after running bd prime/read queries. The files are ignored and tracked source status remained clean, but reviewer writePolicy=readOnly is expected to prevent workspace mutation and the review workflow says children query Beads read-only. Ensure delegated reviewers use bd --readonly without bd prime side effects, or enforce the read-only sandbox over Beads/Dolt internal paths. Add regression coverage that a read-only reviewer query leaves workspace internals unchanged.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 2, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-OBSOLETE. Beads was removed from the repository on 2026-10-03 (CLAUDE.md).
